CustomField.label: Notification Sent Date
CustomField.description: Stamped by GtmReadoutController.publishReadout (sendPublishNotification) once the prospect publish-notification email has actually sent successfully. Left null when the send fails or is skipped (missing prospect email/link) -- the publish itself is never blocked or rolled back by that outcome. Read/write is rep+admin only; guests and content roles have no reason to see this.
